FakeMux does none of this', the output shows qmux raising 'Duplicate key' where the fake answered both, and the page states 'The fake compares no keys, so it answered both purchases that shared one.'
recorded.prompt:q-script-started-q2: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-script-started-q2: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-script-started-q2: 10.3: 'Q2 has to run in the test's JVM: QMUX.getMUX and NameRegistrar.get read the NameRegistrar, a static map per JVM (unit c1), so a test can't reach a Q2 that a script started in another process.' The 10.7 waits table gives getMUX -> 'NameRegistrar.NotFoundException if not registered'.
recorded.prompt:q-sometimes-unavailable: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sometimes-unavailable: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sometimes-unavailable: 10.4: 'q2.ready(timeout) waits until Q2 has deployed the directory once, so the QMUX is registered, but the adaptor may not have connected'. The fix is SpaceFactory.getSpace().rd("host-channel.ready", 10000), 'the entry that isConnected reads'. In 10.1, authorize returns HOST_UNAVAILABLE when !isConnected.
recorded.prompt:q-merchant-city: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merchant-city: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-merchant-city: 10.3.1: 'Nothing checked it on the way in: ISOMsg.set accepts any string, and QMUX queues the message as it is. The adaptor's thread packed it when it wrote to the socket, failed, and dropped the link.' 10.3 and 10.7 add that the FakeMux does no packing ('Neither the fake nor the queue host packs a byte'). The page's example is a merchant name in field 43 rather than a city, but the mechanism carries over directly.

recorded.prompt:q-gateway-tests:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-tests:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-tests:b: Partly plausible, because 10.2 says 'In production that collision takes two requests in flight at once'. The page still refutes it: 'FakeMux does none of this' and 'The fake compares no keys', so no number of threads can make a fake raise Duplicate key.
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-tests:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-tests:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-tests:c: 10.1 FakeMux clones the request for the response and never touches field 11. 10.1.1: 'a fake answers with a new message and leaves the request alone'. 10.2: 'The fake compares no keys, so it answered both purchases that shared one'. So it did receive two requests with one key.
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-tests:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-tests:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-tests:d: 10.2: QMUX 'refuses to send a request it could never match' and 'It refused the second purchase, because one answer would match both'. The output shows the Duplicate key ISOException coming from qmux against a queue host, so QMUX itself raises it before sending and no host reports it.
recorded.prompt:q-script-started-q2:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-script-started-q2:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-script-started-q2:a: 10.3 says getMUX reads 'the NameRegistrar, a static map per JVM'. It does not connect by host and port, and 10.7 says it returns 'at once'.
recorded.prompt:q-script-started-q2:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-script-started-q2:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-script-started-q2:c: 10.3: the NameRegistrar is 'a static map per JVM ... so a test can't reach a Q2 that a script started in another process'. Nothing is published across processes.
recorded.prompt:q-script-started-q2:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-script-started-q2:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-script-started-q2:d: Partly true: the result is a NotFoundException. The page refutes the reason. 10.7 says getMUX returns 'at once', throwing only 'if not registered', and 10.4 says q2.ready only waits for a deployment. The 10.3 per-JVM registry is the real cause, and a test that runs no Q2 has nothing to call ready on.
recorded.prompt:q-sometimes-unavailable:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sometimes-unavailable:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sometimes-unavailable:a: Close call. 10.4 refutes sleeping in general: section title 'Never for a Time', 'That millisecond ... is longer on a loaded build server', 'A test that sleeps two seconds after start ... fails on the build server whenever the host is slow to listen', and the reconnect-delay of 10 seconds. The stem says the host started before Q2, which rules out the page's own failing-sleep case (a host slow to listen). So the rejection rests on the general rule and the loaded-server remark. The page gives 10 s as the adaptor's reconnect-delay, not as a default, so the says field's 'by default' is not on the page.
recorded.prompt:q-sometimes-unavailable:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sometimes-unavailable:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sometimes-unavailable:b: 10.4: after q2.ready the 'QMUX is registered'. The output shows 'q2.ready() returned; host-mux registered, isConnected false', so waiting for the registry adds nothing.
recorded.prompt:q-sometimes-unavailable:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sometimes-unavailable:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sometimes-unavailable:c: 10.4 / 10.6: 'q2.ready means deployed, not connected'. The output shows ready returning at about 276 ms with isConnected still false, so a longer ready timeout does not wait for the link.
recorded.prompt:q-merchant-city:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merchant-city:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-merchant-city:a: 10.3: 'Neither the fake nor the queue host packs a byte'. The 10.7 table marks FakeMux 'no' for packager and framing.
recorded.prompt:q-merchant-city:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merchant-city:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-merchant-city:b: 10.3.1: 'QMUX queues the message as it is. The adaptor's thread packed it when it wrote to the socket'. Packing happens on the adaptor's thread, not the caller's.
